company.name: Hippocratic AI
company.shortDescription: Hippocratic AI is a healthcare technology company that develops safety-focused large-language models for medical applications.
company.description: Hippocratic AI presents a platform that develops safety-focused large language models tailored for healthcare settings. The company offers AI agents designed to engage in non-diagnostic, patient-facing tasks such as preoperative preparation, post-discharge follow-up, and chronic-care management. Its architecture is built on a multi-agent system that aims to reduce clinician burden by managing routine patient interactions, while a clinician-driven test framework ensures service readiness. The service includes an “agent store” where licensed clinicians can design and deploy new agents across diverse specialties, and health systems, payers or providers can deploy them to support outreach and engagement workflows.
